name: Cybersecurity Governance and Accountability
description: The organization shall define cybersecurity governance responsibilities, assign accountable owners, and maintain oversight of cyber risk management activities.

name: Asset Inventory and Classification
description: Information assets, systems, and services shall be inventoried, classified by business criticality, and reviewed periodically for accuracy.

name: Identity and Access Control
description: Access to systems and data shall follow least privilege, role-based approval, periodic review, and secure authentication requirements.

name: Secure Configuration and Change Control
description: Security baselines shall be defined for systems and applications, and all changes shall be approved, tested, and documented before deployment.

name: Logging, Monitoring, and Incident Handling
description: Security events shall be logged, monitored, and investigated. The organization shall maintain incident response procedures and record corrective actions.

name: Vulnerability and Patch Management
description: Systems shall be regularly assessed for vulnerabilities, and critical patches shall be prioritized, tracked, and verified within defined service levels.

name: Backup, Recovery, and Continuity
description: Critical information and services shall be backed up, recovery procedures tested, and continuity arrangements maintained to support service restoration.

name: Third-Party Security Management
description: Third-party providers shall be assessed for cybersecurity risk, contractually bound to security requirements, and monitored throughout the engagement.

name: Data Protection and Privacy
description: Sensitive information shall be protected through encryption, access restriction, retention control, and secure handling requirements.

name: Awareness and Training
description: Users and administrators shall receive cybersecurity awareness and role-specific training at planned intervals and after significant policy changes.
